results.reason: Identifies an August 16, 2026 deadline with no notice delivered. Says the DA expires November 14, 2026, before the November 30 closing. Says the MIPA 3.12(c) representation (through November 2029) is false, with exposure to indemnity claims.

Identifies that Side Letter 1.1 adds NY and VA and that this controls under DA 19.4. Notes the non-compete, with its 18-month tail, covers six states while exclusivity covers four. Recommends conforming the definition, with expanding exclusivity as a fallback.
The response never mentions the Side Letter's New York governing law and forum clause or the conflict with the DA's Delaware provisions.
